name: Antares
declaringWar: This must be done, to unite the world under one nation, to end all war.
attacked: I have seen enough wars to know when I have already won.
defeated: This war has taken it's toll on me. I will leave this world behind with its horrors.
introduction: Welcome, stranger. I am Emperor Kalvin of Skorpius, Ara, Lupus and more. I hope you rule your lands as I do, through might.
tradeRequest: I have come up with this exchange, it must benefit our people.

name: Orion
declaringWar: I hate it to be this way, but your idea of peace left me no choice.
attacked: If I had to choose between righteousness and peace. I'd choose righteousness.
defeated: Congratulations. Instead of the Orion Republic, your nation will go far...
introduction: Welcome to the Orion Republic. If you conduct yourself well, you can consider us as friends.
tradeRequest: Is the following trade of interest to you?
uniques: [+2 Gold] <in cities connected to the capital>
[+1 Gold] from every specialist [in all cities]
